package bus

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestBusScanYesterdayTrial(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("BUS_SCAN_TRIAL_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing synthetic root")
	}
	b, err := OpenAt(filepath.Join(root, "bus.db"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer b.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if os.Getenv("BUS_SCAN_TRIAL_PHASE") == "seed" {
		ws := filepath.Join(root, "workspace")
		if err := os.MkdirAll(ws, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		s, err := b.RegisterSession(ctx, "fixture-sender", ws, "Fixture sender")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		m, err := b.Send(ctx, Sender{Session: &s}, Human, "Old fixture.", nil, 0)
		if err != nil || m.ID != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("old send: %+v %v", m, err)
		}
	} else {
		m, err := b.Message(ctx, 2)
		if err != nil || m.Text != "New fixture." {
			t.Fatalf("new message: %+v %v", m, err)
		}
		original, err := b.Message(ctx, 1)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, _, err := b.Deliver(ctx, original.FromSession, "tool")
		if err != nil || len(got) != 1 || got[0].ID != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("old delivery: %+v %v", got, err)
		}
		s, err := b.Session(ctx, original.FromSession)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		m, err = b.Send(ctx, Sender{Session: &s}, Human, "Old after migration.", nil, 0)
		if err != nil || m.ID != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("old write: %+v %v", m, err)
		}
	}
}
